rvfi_observation.effect: Clear the RVFI write mask for LR.W and LR.D. Compare retirements, register writes and architectural memory writes with Spike, and observe the actual cache update through the subsequent reload.

application_order: checkout CVA6 at cpu_revision and initialize its HPDcache submodule
verify that the reconstructed test has directed_test_source_sha256
run harness/evaluate.sh with the complete submitted hpdcache_amo module

reconstruction.reference_hdl_preconditions: Run reference_hdl from the root of the CVA6 checkout at cpu_revision, with core/cache_subsystem/hpdcache initialized as the cv-hpdcache submodule containing commit f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03. Verify SHA-256 1a0bf5cb2d12f65ce79b7da1173321d8119c744ddd5df09d33dd78317a80bc2f of the retrieved source before use.
reconstruction.test_sources: Use the pinned architectural tests. For a directed test, the evaluator copies the distributed harness/*.S source to <CVA6>/verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches. To reconstruct that source independently, apply its new-file provenance patch in an empty scratch directory and compare the recorded SHA-256; do not apply the provenance patch to either upstream checkout.

test_materialization: ../harness/evaluate_parallel.sh copies the assembly files beside the selected test list into <CVA6>/verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches. The directed test patch is a provenance reconstruction record and is not applied before evaluation.
